scope: US-departure (US exit side) requirement facts for a US citizen relocating Seattle -> Quito on a professional residence visa (US->EC corridor). Covers continuing US federal income tax filing (Form 1040) on worldwide income, foreign earned income exclusion (Form 2555) and its physical presence test, FBAR (FinCEN Form 114) foreign-account reporting, the absence of a Washington State individual income tax (no state exit filing), the absence of a US-Ecuador Social Security totalization agreement, maintaining an SSN for filing, and the automatic 2-month filing extension for citizens abroad. Official sources only (irs.gov, fincen.gov, ssa.gov, dor.wa.gov). Candidate-only; every fact carries a verbatim official quote. STEP / State Dept enrolment could not be sourced (see README gap).
